verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API-based fiat-to-stablecoin path a developer can embed. The Identity API onboards end-user persons and institutions, the Fiat Transfers API creates deposit instructions, and the Mint orchestration automatically converts incoming USD bank transfers into stablecoins and transfers them in one call, with webhooks reporting status. Bank rails are documented only as wire (Fedwire/SWIFT) and CUBIX. missing for 10: card payments, a drop-in embeddable widget/UI, ACH or other consumer-friendly bank rails, independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-user onramp flow.
